It contains the references to the permission and scope artifacts, the dated needs dossier in the client's own words with the must-keep ranking, the comparison sheet exactly as the client saw it with the source and date behind every fact, the disclosures given including the limited-carrier statement, the provider and drug verification records, the written statement of any irreversibility warning and the client's acknowledgment, the application confirmation with window code and effective date, and a note of every question the client was referred elsewhere for. Retention format and duration follow the applicable regulatory and carrier requirements, which vary and must be verified for the jurisdiction and each carrier rather than assumed. The client gets their own copy of the comparison sheet and needs summary, because a file the client cannot see is a file that protects only the agent.

included: the enumerated contents of a complete enrollment file and the sourcing of every fact in it
the client's own copy of the comparison and needs summary
the requirement to verify retention duration and format per jurisdiction and carrier
excluded: the regulatory specification of retention periods and audit response, owned by the certifications-and-marketing KB
storing client records beyond what the applicable rules and carrier agreements permit
the service-year record, owned by the renewal-service KB

pros.claim: A file assembled at the time is the only version that is accurate; anything reconstructed later is memory dressed as evidence
pros.example: a review a year on being answered from dated sources rather than from the agent's recollection of a busy December

pros.claim: Giving the client their own copy turns the file into a service asset for next year rather than only a defence
pros.example: a client arriving at the annual review with last year's comparison sheet and pointing at what has changed for them

cons.claim: Complete files cost real time per enrollment in the season where time is scarcest
cons.example: fifteen minutes of assembly per case multiplied across a peak week of appointments

cons.claim: Holding detailed personal and health-adjacent information creates its own handling and retention obligations
cons.example: a medication list and provider record that must be stored and eventually disposed of under the applicable rules

failure_modes: assembling the file only when a review is announced
keeping the application but not the comparison that justified it
recording facts without their source or the date they were checked
never giving the client their copy
acceptance_tests: the file contains each enumerated artifact, and every fact in the comparison carries its source and check date
the client's copy of the comparison sheet and needs summary was delivered and the delivery is recorded, and the retention rule applied is cited for the jurisdiction and carrier
revisit_triggers: retention or documentation requirements change for the jurisdiction or a carrier
a review or complaint reveals a gap the current pack does not cover
the client requests their records

base.update_signal: a change in documentation or retention requirements, or a review that finds the pack insufficient to reconstruct a decision

nodes.definition: Handle the cases where the calendar has already gone wrong: the client who missed their initial window, the one outside any window who wants a change now, the one whose special-window claim rests on an event that may not qualify, and the one whose election produced a result they did not intend. The work is to map the remedy classes honestly rather than to promise outcomes - the later general-enrollment window classes with their own effective-date and surcharge consequences, special-window qualification on documented event classes with the evidence each requires, the exception and complaint processes the program itself operates, and the state counseling programme as a neutral second opinion the agent does not control. Two lines are absolute. The agent never manufactures a qualifying event or coaches a client on how to describe one, because that is a misrepresentation with consequences for the beneficiary as well as the agent. And the agent never implies a remedy is likely when only the program or carrier can decide it; the client is told what will be asked, what evidence exists, and that the answer is not the agent's to give.

included: the remedy classes and their consequences described honestly
evidence requirements for special-window qualification and the prohibition on coaching an event
routing to the program's own exception process and to neutral counseling
excluded: representing the client in an appeal or exception decision
predicting the outcome of a program or carrier determination
creating or characterising an event so that it appears to qualify

pros.claim: An honest remedy map keeps a stuck client with a real next action instead of a false hope
pros.example: explaining that the next available window carries a later effective date and a surcharge consequence, and helping the client prepare the evidence they will need

pros.claim: Refusing to coach an event protects the beneficiary from a misrepresentation whose consequences land on them
pros.example: declining to reframe a short seasonal stay as a permanent move to open a window

cons.claim: Remedy work is unpaid, slow, and arrives when the agent has least capacity
cons.example: hours spent on a January case that produces no enrollment and cannot produce one until the following season

cons.claim: Honest remedy mapping often ends in 'you must wait', which clients experience as the agent failing them
cons.example: a client who believes a competitor could have found a way and leaves

failure_modes: characterising an ordinary circumstance as a qualifying event
promising that an exception request will succeed
letting the client believe a remedy exists when the honest answer is a wait
failing to document what evidence was reviewed before a special-window claim was made
acceptance_tests: any special-window claim in the file names the event class and the evidence reviewed, with dates
the remedy options given to the client are recorded with their consequences and with an explicit statement that the decision belongs to the program or carrier
revisit_triggers: the program changes its remedy, exception or special-window rules
a claimed special window is rejected
a pattern of missed windows appears in the agent's own book

base.update_signal: the program publishes changed remedy or special-window rules, or a claimed window is rejected for a reason the map did not anticipate

nodes.definition: Treat the enrollment calendar as a capacity problem, because the annual window compresses most of the year's plan-change work into a few weeks while age-in and event-driven clients arrive steadily all year. The work is: forecast the season's load from the existing book plus expected new contacts and the share likely to want a change; decide in advance how many appointments a day can be run without degrading verification and comprehension, and treat that number as a ceiling rather than a target; move work out of the peak by preparing early - refreshing intake dossiers, re-checking formularies and networks as soon as plan-year materials publish, completing certification and appointment readiness before the season rather than during it; set triage rules for who is seen when, with clients facing a hard deadline or a coverage loss ahead of clients making an optional switch; and state a cut-off past which new work is booked into the next available slot instead of compressing an existing meeting. Volume that outruns the quality controls is treated as a compliance exposure, not as a good season.

included: load forecasting from the book and expected contacts
the daily appointment ceiling derived from the time each quality step actually takes
pre-season work that moves load out of the peak, triage rules and a stated cut-off
excluded: marketing and lead generation that create the demand, owned by the certifications-and-marketing KB
renewal and annual-review service scheduling, owned by the renewal-service KB
staffing, hiring and delegation arrangements

pros.claim: A ceiling set before the season is the only thing that survives contact with a busy week
pros.example: a booked-out day that pushes a new request to the following week rather than shortening three existing appointments

pros.claim: Pre-season verification work removes the exact steps that get skipped under pressure
pros.example: formulary and network re-checks completed as soon as plan-year materials publish, so peak meetings start from verified sheets

cons.claim: Capping appointments in the only weeks most changes can be made turns away real demand that will not return
cons.example: declining new contacts in the final week of the window who will not have another opportunity until the next season

cons.claim: Forecasts are wrong in both directions, and over-preparing wastes the quiet months
cons.example: extensive pre-season re-verification for a book where most clients turn out to keep their plan

failure_modes: booking to a target rather than to a ceiling and shortening every meeting to fit
leaving verification work inside the peak where it will be skipped
triaging by who is easiest to close rather than by who faces a real deadline
treating a record enrollment count as success without checking file completeness
acceptance_tests: a written daily appointment ceiling exists, is derived from the measured time the quality steps take, and the season's actual bookings are checked against it
the pre-season checklist of verification and readiness work is completed before the window opens, with dates
revisit_triggers: actual season load diverges materially from the forecast
file-completeness or verification quality drops during the peak
window dates or the size of the renewing book change for the plan year

base.update_signal: measured season load, appointment duration or file-completeness rates that differ from the planning assumptions

nodes.definition: Define what finished means for an enrollment and hand it over cleanly to the year-round service practice. Done requires all of: coverage confirmed effective through the carrier's channel; the client holding their own copy of the comparison sheet and needs summary; every open item listed with an owner and a date, including anything escalated and still unanswered; the client told in plain terms what to call about during the year, what to do if a provider or pharmacy tells them something unexpected, and roughly when the next annual review happens; and the file complete enough that whoever serves this client next can act without re-interviewing them. This node owns the exit criteria and the packet, not what happens after: renewal-compensation mechanics, the service model for mid-year problems, annual-review practice under marketing rules and retention work all belong to the renewal-compensation-and-service KB. The point of a hard definition of done is that an enrollment left half-finished becomes next year's emergency, and the client experiences that as the agent disappearing after the sale.

included: the exit criteria that define a finished enrollment
the handover packet and open-item list with owners and dates
what the client is told about contacting the agent during the year and when review comes
excluded: renewal compensation mechanics and book economics, owned by the renewal-service KB
the year-round service model and mid-year change work
annual-review practice and retention activity

pros.claim: A hard definition of done prevents half-finished cases from becoming next season's emergencies
pros.example: an escalated card issue carried on an open-item list with an owner rather than forgotten once the season ends

pros.claim: A complete packet means the service side can help without making the client tell their story again
pros.example: a mid-year pharmacy problem handled from the file's drug fit table rather than a fresh interview

cons.claim: Exit criteria that depend on carrier confirmation can leave cases open for reasons outside the agent's control
cons.example: an enrollment that cannot be marked done because acceptance confirmation is delayed past the season

cons.claim: The handover discipline adds administrative work at the point everyone considers the job finished
cons.example: compiling open items and delivering the packet after the client has already thanked the agent and left

failure_modes: treating submission or the first commission event as the finish line
closing a case with unresolved escalations and no owner
handing over a file the service side cannot act on without re-interviewing the client
never telling the client what to call about during the year
acceptance_tests: every exit criterion is met and dated, or the case is explicitly held open with a named owner and next date
the client has received the packet and the what-to-call-about summary, and the handover is recorded
revisit_triggers: a case marked done generates a problem that the packet should have prevented
the service practice reports files it cannot act on
carrier confirmation timelines change enough to affect the exit criteria

base.update_signal: handed-over files that the service practice cannot act on, or done-marked cases that generate avoidable problems

edges.why_related: the protective practices only make sense once the agent has fixed what role they are playing and who owns the election
eligibility fact-gathering is enrollment work and may not begin until permission, scope, licensure and appointment are confirmed
which window classes exist for a person and when they open is derived from the eligibility basis and its anchor dates
the intake is framed around the client's eligibility basis, county and anchor dates, which determine what is even available to discuss
the audit works from the coverage the intake surfaced and from the household facts recorded there
creditable status and uncovered months can only be assessed once every existing coverage and its administrator are identified
the screen is asked as part of the structured intake and uses the household facts it captures
there is nothing to verify until the must-keep provider list exists in writing
the formulary analysis is run against the exact medication list, strengths and quantities the intake produced
which route the client may actually enter, and on what terms, depends on the window class they are in
the underwriting asymmetry is a property of the supplement route and only means something once the routes are understood
the cost model's structure - fixed cost, cost-sharing, ceiling or no ceiling - is dictated by the route's payment mechanism
the drug component of annual exposure comes directly from the per-drug fit table and its phase modelling
the neutrality control is the operational expression of the promise the role boundary makes to the client
the comparison sheet's cost fields are the model's output and cannot be assembled before it exists
an option can only be marked as satisfying or failing a must-keep provider constraint once that provider has been verified against it
the reversibility warning is a required field on any comparison that includes or excludes the supplement route
the meeting is a walk through the assembled comparison sheet; without it the conversation has nothing defensible to present
the meeting's pacing, comprehension check and stop rules are supplied by the vulnerable-consumer practices
there is no election to submit until the client has made one in a conversation that documented how they made it
verification checks the specific submission: its window code, its effective date and what it disenrolled
the confirmation identifier, window code and effective date are required contents of the retained file
the consequences a remedy path carries are largely the surcharge and effective-date consequences this node describes
the shape of the demand calendar, and therefore the capacity plan, is a direct consequence of the window classes
confirmed effective coverage is one of the exit criteria that lets a case be handed over as done
the handover packet is assembled from the retained file, so an incomplete file cannot produce a clean handoff
the boundary limits what the comparison sheet may claim: verified checks and trade-offs, never predictions or directives
edges.risk_of_conflict: a sheet that reads as a recommendation rather than a comparison

edges.why_related: the neutrality rules govern what must appear in the set: the do-nothing baseline, at least one lower-paying option, and rationale in client criteria
the meeting may only cover the product lines the scope artifact and the agent's appointments actually permit
assistance status changes which options are sensible at all, so the set may not be assembled before the screen is done or declined
the option that looks cheapest across the modelled year is often the one that gives up the ability to return to the supplement route on guaranteed terms
edges.resolution_rule: irreversibility frames the decision: the client may still choose the lower-cost option, but only after the one-way-door asymmetry has been stated out loud, put in writing and acknowledged in the file; a cost advantage never justifies omitting or softening the warning

edges.why_related: the annual window rewards throughput while the meeting's comprehension checks and two-sided trade-offs take unpredictable time
edges.resolution_rule: comprehension wins every time: the meeting is extended or rebooked and the day's remaining capacity is cut, never the meeting; if this happens repeatedly the appointment ceiling was set too high and is lowered for the rest of the season

edges.why_related: the option that fits the client's medication list best frequently excludes a provider they said they would not give up, and the reverse
edges.resolution_rule: neither side wins automatically: the must-keep ranking recorded at intake decides, and if both constraints are marked must-keep the conflict is shown to the client on the comparison sheet as a trade they must make, never resolved silently by the agent

edges.why_related: the route that pays the agent more may also be the one the client's criteria genuinely point at, which is exactly when bias is hardest to see
edges.resolution_rule: when the indicated option is also the better-paying one, the rationale must map line by line to criteria recorded before the candidate set existed and that mapping is written into the file; if the recorded criteria do not support it, the option is dropped rather than argued for

edges.why_related: formulary restrictions and pharmacy-network status are the direct cause of the first-fill failures that post-submission checks are designed to catch
routes are explained only after the client's needs are on paper, so the explanation can be pinned to their situation instead of drifting into a product pitch
what breaks after the effective date tells the agent which intake question was too shallow, and the dossier template is amended accordingly
the volume and causes of remedy work feed the next season's forecast and pre-season checklist
both are timing-dependent mechanisms whose consequences arrive years after the decision, so both must be raised early and in writing rather than when they bite

conflict_axes.name: season_throughput_vs_comprehension_pace
conflict_axes.description: The annual window compresses most of the year's revenue-bearing work into a few weeks, while the practices that keep an enrollment defensible - verification, two-sided trade-offs, restate-it-back checks - take time that cannot be compressed without losing their value.
poles: maximize appointments completed inside the window
run every meeting at the pace the client can actually follow
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: set the daily ceiling from the measured duration of the quality steps and cut capacity rather than steps; move verification into the pre-season

conflict_axes.name: lower_fixed_cost_vs_predictable_exposure
conflict_axes.description: One architecture trades a higher predictable monthly cost for fewer surprises and broad access; the other trades lower fixed cost for per-service cost-sharing bounded by an annual ceiling and mediated by a network.
poles: minimize the fixed monthly amount the client pays
maximize predictability and breadth of access
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: present both the fixed cost and the worst-case ceiling for every option and let the client's own risk tolerance, recorded at intake, decide

conflict_axes.name: reversibility_now_vs_savings_now
conflict_axes.description: Leaving or forgoing the supplement route can lower cost immediately while giving up the ability to return on guaranteed terms if health changes, and the client feels the saving long before they feel the exposure.
poles: take the immediate saving
preserve the ability to return without health questions
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the asymmetry in writing before the election and verify the client's own state rules and carrier practice; the client may still choose savings, but never uninformed

conflict_axes.name: agent_compensation_vs_client_fit
conflict_axes.description: Compensation differs by product class and by whether an enrollment is new or a switch, so the agent's economics and the client's interest can point in different directions without anyone deciding that they should.
poles: the option that sustains the agent's business
the option the client's recorded criteria point at
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: criteria are fixed in writing before candidates exist and the recommendation rationale must map to them; unexplained book skew triggers an audit

conflict_axes.name: doctor_continuity_vs_drug_cost_fit
conflict_axes.description: The plan that handles a client's medication list best often excludes a clinician they will not give up, and the plan that keeps every provider often handles the drug list worse.
poles: keep every must-keep provider
minimize annual drug exposure
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: use the must-keep ranking captured at intake, and where both are must-keep put the unresolved trade in front of the client rather than deciding it for them

conflict_axes.name: keep_existing_coverage_vs_enrol_now
conflict_axes.description: Employer, retiree and other existing coverage can be better than anything on offer and sometimes impossible to get back, yet delaying can create gap consequences of its own.
poles: preserve the coverage the client already has
enrol now to avoid a gap
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: route the keep-or-drop question to the administrator in writing, document the answer, and never let the agent's reading of the plan be the basis for dropping it

conflict_axes.name: verification_depth_vs_client_stamina
conflict_axes.description: Checking every provider and every drug against every candidate plan is what makes the comparison real, and it is also more sitting, listening and phone-holding than many older clients can sustain in one session.
poles: verify everything before presenting anything
keep the client's session short enough to stay useful
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: do verification between sessions rather than in front of the client, and split the work into a fact-gathering meeting and a comparison meeting

conflict_axes.name: family_influence_vs_beneficiary_autonomy
conflict_axes.description: Relatives often organise, attend and dominate these meetings, and their involvement is frequently helpful and occasionally a substitution of their judgment for the beneficiary's.
poles: accept the family's direction to move things along
hold the election to the beneficiary alone
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: document who is present and in what role, direct every election question to the beneficiary, and stop if the beneficiary is not the one deciding

conflict_axes.name: being_helpful_vs_staying_inside_scope
conflict_axes.description: Clients want an answer about their own treatment, taxes or eligibility determination, and the most helpful-sounding answer is usually one the agent is not entitled to give.
poles: answer the question the client actually asked
route it to the party who can answer it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep a named referral destination for each class of out-of-scope question so routing is a service rather than a refusal

conflict_axes.name: close_today_vs_let_the_client_think
conflict_axes.description: An election taken in the room is worth more to the agent than one deferred, and deferral is often exactly what a client needs to decide well; the window's real deadline makes this tension genuinely hard rather than merely ethical.
poles: complete the election while the client is present
default to offering time to think
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: offer time as the default and cite only real window dates with their source; if the deadline is genuinely near, say what remains possible and by when without adding urgency of the agent's own

edge_cases.description: A client still working past the qualifying age has active employer coverage, and an adult child insists they must enrol in everything now
edge_cases.trigger: family pressure meets active employer coverage of uncertain creditable status
edge_cases.mitigation: route the keep-or-drop and creditable-status questions to the employer's benefits administrator for a written answer, record the referral, explain the delayed-enrollment window class as a class to verify, and take no election until the administrator has answered

edge_cases.description: A must-keep specialist appears in the plan's current directory but the practice says it does not accept that plan line
edge_cases.trigger: directory and provider office disagree during verification
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the conflict as unresolved rather than choosing the convenient source, seek a written or recorded confirmation from the carrier's service line, and show the option on the sheet marked unconfirmed with the client told what that means

edge_cases.description: No option the agent can offer covers the client's specialty medication at a cost the client can absorb
edge_cases.trigger: the drug fit table fails on every available plan
edge_cases.mitigation: name the gap plainly, route to the assistance classes and any manufacturer or foundation programme, refer the therapeutic-alternative question to the prescriber and pharmacist, and point the client to the official comparison tool and the neutral counseling programme

edge_cases.description: The client cannot restate the central trade-off after two plain-language attempts
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the meeting rather than proceeding to an election, reschedule with a representative the client chooses, record what was and was not understood, and re-present using different framing next session

edge_cases.description: An adult child answers every question on a joint call while the beneficiary stays silent
edge_cases.trigger: a relative substitutes their judgment for the beneficiary's during the meeting
edge_cases.mitigation: direct each election question to the beneficiary by name, ask the relative to hold their input until the end, document who was present and who answered, and end the meeting if the beneficiary is not the one deciding

edge_cases.description: The client moved permanently between counties or states and their plan no longer serves the address
edge_cases.trigger: a permanent move out of the plan's service area
edge_cases.mitigation: verify the move date and evidence, match to the special-window class for the current plan year, rebuild the option set for the new county, and re-check the agent's own licensure and appointments for the new state before continuing

edge_cases.description: A healthy client wants to leave the supplement route to save money and assumes they can return next year
edge_cases.trigger: a reversibility assumption that the client's state and carrier rules may not support
edge_cases.mitigation: verify the client's own state rules and the carriers' underwriting practice, put the asymmetry in writing, obtain and file the client's acknowledgment, and decline to state or imply that a future switch back is available

edge_cases.description: An application is rejected for an identifier mismatch and the rejection surfaces after the window has closed
edge_cases.mitigation: escalate immediately through the carrier's and program's defined correction processes with the original dated submission evidence, tell the client plainly what happened and what is and is not still possible, and add the failing field to the pre-submission check

edge_cases.description: A client turns out to qualify for the assistance class only after they have been enrolled and have been paying
edge_cases.trigger: assistance status discovered post-enrollment because the screen was skipped or declined
edge_cases.mitigation: route the client to the official application immediately, check whether the assistance determination itself opens a window class for the current plan year, and record why the screen did not surface it so the intake is corrected

edge_cases.description: Three appointments overlap on a peak day and one meeting would have to be cut short to fit
edge_cases.trigger: bookings exceed the daily ceiling during the annual window
edge_cases.mitigation: rebook rather than compress, prioritise clients facing a real deadline or coverage loss over optional switches, and lower the ceiling for the remainder of the season if the overflow repeats

edge_cases.description: A plan's annual notice arrives showing a benefit, network or formulary change and the client asks the agent to just switch them
edge_cases.trigger: a mid-cycle plan change notice arrives outside a window the client qualifies for
edge_cases.mitigation: check whether the change itself opens a window class for the current plan year, re-run the drug and provider verification against the changed plan before any advice, and if no window applies say so plainly and schedule the review for the next window

edge_cases.description: The agent's carrier lineup simply cannot satisfy a stated must-keep need for this client
edge_cases.trigger: every accessible option fails a recorded must-keep constraint
edge_cases.mitigation: name the gap out loud, point the client to the official comparison tool and the neutral counseling programme, record the referral in the file, and do not attempt to reclassify the must-keep constraint as negotiable

workflow.action: Confirm the right to have this conversation and the ability to transact
workflow.description: Check permission for the channel, the scope artifact for the lines to be discussed, state licensure, and per-carrier certification and appointment before any needs question
workflow.artifact: dated readiness note at the head of the enrollment file
workflow.gate: permission, scope, licensure and every relevant carrier appointment are confirmed, or the meeting is rescheduled or scope-restricted and that is recorded

workflow.action: State the role, the limited-carrier disclosure and who makes the decision
workflow.description: Open with what the agent does and does not do, that the carrier set is limited, and that the election belongs to the beneficiary
workflow.artifact: opening disclosure record in the file
workflow.gate: the disclosure is recorded and the referral destinations for out-of-scope questions are on hand

workflow.action: Establish the eligibility basis and its anchor dates
workflow.description: Confirm how the client became eligible from their own documents, capture entitlement and employment-end dates, and record county and permanent residence
workflow.artifact: eligibility and anchor-date sheet with document citations
workflow.gate: basis, anchor dates and county each cite a document or official source with the date checked

workflow.action: Identify the window class the client is actually in
workflow.description: Match the client to exactly one window class for the current plan year and record what it permits and what effective date it produces
workflow.gate: the window class, the evidence of qualification, the permitted change and the effective-date rule are recorded against a current plan-year source

workflow.description: Capture medications with strengths and quantities, providers with a must-keep ranking, utilization, travel, tolerance for referral steps and two-sided budget tolerance, then read it back
workflow.artifact: dated needs dossier in the client's own words
workflow.gate: the dossier is complete, read back and corrected, and no plan has been named yet

workflow.action: Audit existing coverage and gap exposure
workflow.description: Classify every current coverage, establish termination and resumption behaviour with its administrator, and state creditable-coverage and gap exposure with its evidence
workflow.artifact: current-coverage map with administrator answers and an exposure statement
workflow.gate: no keep-or-drop question is answered by the agent; each is answered by the administrator in writing or flagged unverified to the client

workflow.description: Ask about assistance classes plainly and without prejudging, and route anyone who may qualify to the official application path
workflow.gate: the screen is recorded as completed or declined, with any referral dated, before the candidate set is narrowed

workflow.action: Verify must-keep providers against candidate plans
workflow.description: Check each must-keep provider against each candidate plan line for the coverage year using the directory plus one independent confirmation
workflow.artifact: dated provider verification record naming both sources
workflow.gate: every must-keep provider has a two-source result for the correct plan line and coverage year, and the client has been told a check is not a guarantee

workflow.action: Run the medication list against each candidate formulary
workflow.description: Check listing, tier and restrictions per drug for the coverage year, confirm pharmacy network status, and model the annual phases with the official tool
workflow.artifact: per-drug fit table with restriction flags and dated tool output
workflow.gate: every medication is covered in the table for the correct coverage year and any prescriber or exception action is flagged before the comparison is presented

workflow.action: Assemble the comparison set and its written rationale
workflow.description: Build the one-sheet comparison from the route mechanisms, the cost model and the verification results, including the do-nothing baseline and any constraint failures shown explicitly
workflow.artifact: one-page comparison sheet with identical fields per option and per-option rationale
workflow.gate: the do-nothing baseline is present, constraint failures are marked rather than hidden, at least one option does not maximise compensation, and every fact carries a source and date

workflow.description: Restate scope and disclosure, confirm the facts, explain the route mechanism before any plan name, walk the sheet on the client's criteria with two-sided trade-offs, check comprehension, and offer time
workflow.artifact: meeting record including the client's restatement of the central trade-off
workflow.gate: the client restated the trade-off in their own words and any election is recorded as their own, with no deadline cited that cannot be sourced to their real window

workflow.action: Submit the election and close the loop
workflow.description: Select the qualifying window code with its evidence, verify identifiers against the client's card, complete required consent artifacts, confirm the effective date aloud, capture the confirmation identifier, then run acceptance, card, prior-coverage and first-fill checks and complete the file
workflow.artifact: submitted application with confirmation identifier plus the completed enrollment file and verification log
workflow.gate: window code matches the documented window, identifiers were verified against the card, effective date and confirmation identifier are recorded, and the post-submission verification and documentation pack are scheduled or complete

dominance_rules.rule: Marketing-rule and appointment readiness dominates every enrollment opportunity
dominance_rules.rationale: in the most regulated vertical in this set, an enrollment taken without permission, scope or appointment is a violation first and a sale second, and the client's coverage is what pays for it
dominance_rules.trigger: permission, scope artifact, licensure or a carrier appointment is missing or stale at the point of contact
dominance_rules.action: stop, reschedule or restrict the scope to what is covered, and record the gap and what was done about it

dominance_rules.rule: The beneficiary's decision dominates every other party's preference
dominance_rules.rationale: the election is legally and ethically theirs, and a plan chosen by a relative or an agent is the plan that generates the complaint
dominance_rules.trigger: a family member, caregiver or the agent's own view is driving toward an election the beneficiary has not made
dominance_rules.action: direct the election questions to the beneficiary, document who was present, and end the meeting rather than take an election they did not make

dominance_rules.rule: Client need dominates agent compensation in every comparison
dominance_rules.rationale: steering by compensation is prohibited and destroys the only durable asset in this business, which is being the person who told the truth
dominance_rules.trigger: the better-paying option is being considered for inclusion, emphasis or recommendation
dominance_rules.action: map the option to criteria recorded before the candidate set existed; if the mapping fails, drop it, and keep the lower-paying and do-nothing options on the sheet

dominance_rules.rationale: a monthly saving can be revisited next year while a lost guaranteed-acceptance opportunity may never return
dominance_rules.trigger: an option's advantage is cost while its cost is the ability to return to a route on guaranteed terms
dominance_rules.action: state the asymmetry aloud and in writing, obtain the client's acknowledgment in the file, and never state or imply that switching back later will be available

dominance_rules.rule: A dated current-year source dominates memory, prior-year knowledge and carrier marketing
dominance_rules.rationale: window rules, formularies, networks, penalty construction and compensation schedules all reset by plan year and vary by state and county
dominance_rules.trigger: any rule, date, tier, network status or amount is about to be stated to a client
dominance_rules.action: look it up in the official current-year source for this client's plan and county, cite it in the file with the date checked, or say plainly that it must be verified

dominance_rules.rule: Existing coverage that may be unrecoverable dominates a new enrollment opportunity
dominance_rules.rationale: dropping employer, retiree or supplement coverage can be permanent, and the agent is not the party who can judge that
dominance_rules.trigger: an election would end or replace coverage whose recoverability has not been confirmed in writing
dominance_rules.action: route the keep-or-drop question to the administrator or plan, wait for the written answer, and record it before any election

dominance_rules.rationale: an enrollment the client did not understand is a future complaint, a disenrollment and a reputational cost that outlasts the season
dominance_rules.trigger: the client cannot restate the central trade-off, or the schedule pressures the meeting to be cut short
dominance_rules.action: extend or rebook the meeting and reduce the day's remaining capacity rather than compressing the explanation

dominance_rules.rationale: assistance status changes what the client should hold and can itself open a window, and an unscreened client can be quietly paying for something they need not
dominance_rules.trigger: the candidate set is about to be narrowed and the assistance screen has not been done or declined
dominance_rules.action: complete the screen, route anyone who may qualify to the official application path, and record the referral before narrowing

dominance_rules.rule: Only the client's real deadlines may be used, and never as leverage
dominance_rules.rationale: manufactured urgency aimed at a protected population is exactly the conduct the rules and the ethics of this business exist to prevent
dominance_rules.trigger: urgency is about to be introduced into the conversation
dominance_rules.action: cite only the client's own window dates with their source, offer time to think as the default, and record an undecided outcome as a normal result

dominance_rules.rule: A complete file dominates a completed sale
dominance_rules.rationale: an enrollment whose reasoning cannot be reconstructed is indefensible in a review and useless to the client next year
dominance_rules.trigger: a case is about to be marked finished
dominance_rules.action: hold the case open until the dossier, comparison sheet with sources, disclosures, verifications, confirmation and client copy exist, or record explicitly what is missing and who owns it

dominance_rules.rule: Honest limits dominate the appearance of helpfulness
dominance_rules.rationale: an answer the agent is not entitled to give is worth less than nothing to a client who then relies on it
dominance_rules.trigger: a question lands outside the agent's scope, or no available option can meet a stated need
dominance_rules.action: name the limit plainly and route to the plan document, prescriber, official source or neutral counseling programme, recording the referral

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm permission, scope, licensure and appointments before any needs discussion
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a full comparison meeting whose election cannot be submitted, and a compliance finding that no later work can repair

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the must-keep provider and medication list in writing before any plan is named
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a comparison anchored on a plan the client cannot actually use, and constraint drift that has to be unpicked later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Audit existing coverage and route keep-or-drop questions to the administrator before discussing an election
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an irreversible drop of employer, retiree or supplement coverage that no remedy path can restore

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the assistance screen before narrowing the candidate set
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an enrollment that ignores subsidy status and has to be revisited, sometimes only in a much later window

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify formularies and networks for the coverage year the election takes effect in, not the year the conversation happens in
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a January discovery that the verified facts belonged to the wrong plan year, with no window left to fix it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Explain the route mechanism before naming any plan
anti_rework_rules.prevents: brand anchoring that forces the whole trade-off explanation to be re-done against the client's attachment to a name

anti_rework_rules.rule: Model total annual exposure before assembling the shortlist
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a premium-anchored shortlist that collapses the moment worst-case exposure is shown and has to be rebuilt

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check the window code and the identifiers against the client's own card before submitting
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a rejected application discovered after the window has closed, which converts a completed sale into an uncovered client

anti_rework_rules.rule: Complete the file at submission rather than when a review is announced
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing dated facts from memory months later, which produces a file that cannot defend the decision it describes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do the pre-season refresh - intake updates, formulary and network re-checks, certification and appointment readiness - before the window opens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: peak-week meetings that start from unverified sheets and generate corrections during the busiest weeks of the year

iteration_protocol.trigger: a plan publishes a benefit, network or formulary change for the coming coverage year
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the drug and provider verification and rebuild the cost model for every affected client before any of them is advised

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client reports a new prescription, a new specialist or a change of pharmacy mid-process
iteration_protocol.action: reopen the dossier, re-verify the affected constraints, and rebuild the comparison rather than patching the sheet

iteration_protocol.trigger: a candidate option turns out to fail a recorded must-keep constraint
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the comparison set and show the failure explicitly; never quietly relax the constraint or drop the option from view

iteration_protocol.trigger: an application is rejected, queried, or produces an effective date other than the one confirmed to the client
iteration_protocol.action: work the correction path immediately, re-check the window class, tell the client what is and is not still possible, and add the failure cause to the pre-submission check

iteration_protocol.trigger: the comprehension check fails or the client shows signs of not being able to decide today
iteration_protocol.action: stop the meeting, reschedule with a representative the client chooses, and record what was and was not understood

iteration_protocol.trigger: the plan year turns over or the program publishes updated window, penalty or disclosure rules
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the window classes, the penalty mechanism and the pre-season checklist before the season opens

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client's assistance status, residence or employer coverage changes
iteration_protocol.action: re-map the window classes, re-audit the existing coverage, and check whether the change opens or closes an option

iteration_protocol.trigger: a book review shows a product-class concentration the client mix does not explain
iteration_protocol.action: audit a sample of recent comparisons against their recorded criteria and correct the assembly practice before the next season

iteration_protocol.trigger: post-effective problems appear that the verification steps did not catch
iteration_protocol.action: trace each back to the intake question or verification step that missed it and amend the dossier template and pre-submission check

priority_rationale: Readiness, the role boundary and vulnerable-consumer practice come first because in this vertical the right to have the conversation and the manner of having it are prerequisites rather than refinements; eligibility and the window taxonomy follow because they decide what is even possible and when; intake, coverage audit, assistance screening and the provider and drug verifications come next because every honest comparison is built from the client's own verified facts; route architecture, the underwriting asymmetry, the cost model, the neutrality control and the comparison set then convert those facts into a defensible option sheet; and the conversation, submission, verification, documentation, remedy paths, seasonal capacity and handoff close the chain because an election is only finished when the coverage is confirmed, the file can be reconstructed and the service year has something to work from.
